old:
DO kk=2,k_end
     k=kk-1
     DO i=i_start, i_end
       ww(i,kk,j)=ww(i,kk-1,j)-dnw(kk-1)*((c1h(k)*dmdt(i))+dvdxi(i,kk-1)+(c1h(k)*mu_tend(i,j)))/msfty(i,j)
     ENDDO
     END DO
!  NOTE:  ww_1 (large timestep ww) is already coupled with the

     DO k=1,k_end
     DO i=i_start, i_end
       ww(i,k,j)=ww(i,k,j)-ww_1(i,k,j)
     END DO
     END DO
